name: BI Settings Storage Scope Test
data:
BI Settings Storage Scope Test

Exercises the native BI browser settings bridge only. This harness compares one-key JSON blob storage, many discrete keys, and current-user scope behavior using `saveSettings`, `loadSettings`, `getUser`, and `runQuery`.

Bridge checking SQL checking

Bridge And User Scope

Use this section when switching between Fishbowl users to verify whether `cdx.bi.scope` is isolated per login.

JSON Blob Strategy

Stores many logical properties under one key: `cdx.bi.blob`.

No blob test run yet.

Discrete Key Strategy

Stores values under `cdx.bi.d.001` through `cdx.bi.d.500`.

Exact SQL row counts for discrete keys are reliable when using a fresh user or stepping upward 10 -> 100 -> 500. The native BI settings API exposes no delete operation, so previously-created discrete rows remain in storage.

Attempts to query `UserProperties` for keys under the `cdx.bi.%` prefix. If Fishbowl blocks that query, the save/load bridge tests still remain valid.
